correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the full statement for finite nonreflexive rooted stars, m>=1 propositional letters, k>=1 integer counting grades, and constants top/bottom. Induction makes every terminal formula a monotone propositional upset; root theories are precisely root atoms and all truncated upset measures. A symmetric-chain decomposition into b_m=binom(m,floor(m/2)) chains retaining the highest k successor copies in each preserves every upset count simultaneously, giving the kb_m bound. The middle-rank antichain witnesses the matching lower bound for all equivalent stars, including arbitrary non-induced replacements. For m=2 the five nonempty upsets yield exactly five tests and a disjoint t,s signature enumeration gives N_k=C(k+3,4)+C(k+2,3)+C(k+3,3), pointed types 4N_k. Independent exact two-letter enumeration checked k=1..10, independent chain/upset compression checked m<=4,k<=4 including exhaustive small cases, and sharpness witnesses checked m=1..7. Finite tests are corroboration, not the proof of the unbounded theorem.
